sentences.ar: جو ورفيقه وقفوا عند بيت الأرملة دوغلاس.
sentences.en: Joe and his companion stopped at the Widow Douglas’s house.

sentences.ar: جو حكى عن إشي عمله زوجها معه زمان.
sentences.en: Joe spoke of something her husband had done to him long ago.
He knocked at the nearest door and shouted.
The men went up the hill with their weapons.
Joe fled in the dark once again.

sentences.ar: هَك ما بده حدا يعرف إنه هو.
sentences.en: Huck did not want anyone to know it was him.
